acceptance_tests: does not set selected_source_verified by hand
does not use observed masses, mixings, gauge constants, or benchmark residuals
emits A_selected and b_selected from one branch source
passes D_E, Riesz/gap, reduced Green, dotD, and C1 response audits honestly

S0_selected_source.origin: selected Strominger/HYM minimizer on fixed q79/F,m=1 S3/GS sector

proof.statement: There is a theorem-derived selected smooth source in the fixed q79/F,m=1 S3/GS Route-C sector. This closes S0 only as source provenance; it does not emit finite rho_E, D_E, Riesz/Green, dotD, or C1 values.

S1_transition_or_connection_trace.origin: Phi_fin Cech/Galerkin trace of selected minimizer
required_evidence: non-identity selected rho_E or equivalent selected connection
preservation of S3/GS class and branch orientation

S2_operator_blocks.origin: same selected connection in the Route-C finite basis
required_evidence: dotD_alpha1 matrices from the same branch
finite truncation error controlled by the selected gap

S3_alpha1_source_vector.origin: retarded overlap derivative of the same branch
required_evidence: b_selected is not borrowed from a benchmark or observed flavor row

S4_hessian_and_zero_modes.origin: selected Hess_Xi and Galerkin zero-mode basis
required_evidence: L2 Gram-Schmidt rule fixed from source metric

S5_c1_contractions_and_response.origin: primitive C1 overlaps in selected zero-mode basis
required_evidence: sector response matrices M_u, M_d, M_e, M_nuD emitted
A_selected assembled from emitted response matrices

forbidden_shortcuts: copy hypothetical_selected packets into proof data
flip selected_source_verified flags without a source theorem
use observed masses, mixings, gauge constants, or benchmark residuals
use diagnostic non-invariant C1 candidates as selected primitive data
use principal-symbol-only Hess_Xi as finite Hessian blocks

minimum_new_payload: canonical finite Cech/Galerkin trace map from the selected minimizer
selected non-identity rho_E or connection values
D_E blocks, Riesz gaps, reduced Green operators
same-branch dotD_alpha1 matrices with error bounds
next_computation.name: construct S1-S2 Phi_fin finite trace from the S0 selected source

advanced_packet.purpose: Break the selected-source/C1-rebuild circularity by deriving every required finite operator slot as the image of one selected Phi_fin source.

minimal_remaining_lemma.name: SelectedPhiFinFiniteTraceLemma
minimal_remaining_lemma.statement: For the S0 selected smooth source, the canonical finite Cech/Galerkin trace emits non-identity rho_E/connection data, sector projectors, D_E, Riesz/gap, reduced Green, and same-branch dotD_alpha1 blocks in the Route-C validator basis with certified truncation error.
minimal_remaining_lemma.why_minimal: Once this lemma is proved, S1-S2 can be filled without selected flag lifting; S3-S5 then become ordinary emitted-overlap computations.

s0_theorem.name: SelectedSmoothSourcePrefix
s0_theorem.statement: The fixed q79/F,m=1 S3/GS sector plus the MTT Strominger/HYM selection theorem supplies a theorem-derived selected smooth source. The source is not a lifted finite packet, not a fixture, and not selected from observed constants.

why_this_does_not_yet_close_validators: The q79 and SM-parity validators require finite selected payload values, not just the existence of the smooth selected source. S1 and S2 must still construct the functorial Phi_fin trace and error/gap certificate.
